verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (Virtual Mail) offers AI summaries, auto-labeling and an MCP server, so a buyer can fairly ask whether customer mail data is used to train AI models. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, no data-use policy and no no-training commitment. Encryption, access-controlled facilities and address privacy are different controls and do not answer this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
